verdict.rationale: The products page only makes generic transparency claims: "Transparent fees," "Flat, scoped pricing with what's included – clearly," and an "All-inclusive" contrast against billable hours and add-ons. None of these shows an actual price breakdown, and "all-inclusive" leaves it unclear whether government fees are bundled into the price. Missing for 10: published price figures, explicit separation of Plymouth's legal fees from USCIS filing fees, premium processing fees listed or itemized, and an all-in cost example or independent corroboration.
